In the early [[Standard day|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic]], a '''destructive war''' was waged between the [[Aleena]] and [[Kindalo]] [[species]], the two [[Sentience|sentient]] species living on the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Aleen]]. The war was waged with technological weapons, decimating both species. At one point, the Aleena and Kindalo agreed to a [[Aleena–Kindalo treaty|treaty]] that left the Aleena on the surface, and the Kindalo in the [[Aleen Underworld|underworld]]. The [[Great Seal]] was created to divide the two species.<ref name="NoP" />

Over [[time]], the Aleena remembered the war only through oral recollections and complex [[pictogram]]s that adorned [[stone]] statues built by the Aleena around their settlements.<ref name="NoP" />
